rows.en: Appearing in the orbit of Mars, slowly… yet surely heading for the Earth: the mysterious giant fortress spaceship Naager.
What could its purpose be? Eerily slowly, the Naager sailed through the pitch-black void of space.
Captain! Are we really just going to leave it alone!?
Captain! Let's sortie!
I agree with Soga, too.
That's for Command to decide!
Well, that's why… if you could make a recommendation to the Director, you see? So that somehow we could, you know… handle it ourselves…

That's enough!

Our mission is the defense of the Earth, first and last!

Even if we're now authorized to use force beyond strict self-defense, that doesn't mean we can attack something just because it's come near the Earth's sphere!
But still… you can't honestly think that giant monstrosity is friendly to Earth, can you!?
It's true… it hasn't answered any of our hails.

Yes, Ultra Garrison here…

Captain, it's Staff Officer Manabe.
Mm…

The truth is… we've kept this secret even from you until now…

It's about the mysterious space fortress that appeared near Mars the other day.
Yes, sir… It's all anyone here is talking about.
That is a space fortress of our TDF… no, to be precise, of SIDO.

What did you say!?

Then, is it on its way back to Earth?
Mm… That's the problem.
Meaning what, sir…?
As you know, SIDO is an organization that was merged with us, the TDF, twelve years ago.

Yes… I've heard that at the time it was the Space Investigation and Defense Organization, in charge of the outer solar system.

What about it…?
For us too, this is the first time in a full twelve years that we've laid eyes on that space fortress…
Sir… I don't quite follow…?
In a word… that ship belongs to Earth, and yet it no longer does.
Fifteen years ago… it left Earth for a certain purpose, but lost contact on the way.
Then… a ship that's been missing for fifteen years is only now trying to return to Earth?

Mm… If that were all, there'd be no problem…

What worries us is that we can't reach Director Sakomizu, who should be on board as its captain.
Sakomizu…!?
Mm… He was apparently the former director of SIDO.

Director…?

Don't tell me, [HERO2]…
He's my father…
Your… father?

Kiichi Sakomizu…

Former director of SIDO, and fifteen years ago, captain of what was then the most advanced ship of its day, the space exploration ship NAAGER…

And I… was trained to be the NAAGER's chief pilot.
You were aboard that monstrosity!?
Yeah… Along with [HERO4] here.
Aboard the mothership of the battle fleet nation Naager…? What does that mean?
Don't tell me? You've been deceiving us!?

No!

[HERO2] would never deceive any of you!

We know that perfectly well!

But… it's the first I've heard that you were on that ship. [HERO2], what's this all about?

I used to be a TDF Air Force pilot, with the rank of first lieutenant.

Partly through my father's connections, I got permission to board the NAAGER on secondment to SIDO!

But… my body was invaded by Number Ten's living metal, and when I came to… I found I could clad myself in the Roaring Steel.
And that's… the Knight of Darkness, Lucifard!?

Yeah…

And I waged every kind of invasion from planet to planet, burning innocent people to the ground…
[HERO2]… You don't have to put it like that…

No… The infamy of being an S-Class Most Wanted criminal of the Galactic Federation isn't just for show!

The proof is solid, and the cruelty is beyond tolerance… I am the Black Knight Lucifard!
Sakomizu…?
But… what do you mean, that ship belongs to Earth and yet it doesn't…
It's Number Ten…
Wawawa… G-Grandpa…!?
Seijiro, what are you doing here?

I had quite a time finding this place… There are so many shops that look just like it.

But, well… it seems I've made it. Would you be Mr. Tachibana? My granddaughter's been a real burden on you…

Not at all…

More importantly, what's this Number Ten?
An intelligent life form that serves as the carrier of Vol Cells! Needless to say, it's an extraterrestrial organism…
Vol Cells?
An extraterrestrial intelligent life form?
I've never heard… I've never heard any of this before! Grandpa, what's going on?

Forgive me! I've kept quiet until now, but…

the one who experimentally put Vol Cells into your bodies was my son… in other words, [HERO4]… your father!
What!? Seijiro, what did you just…?

That's a lie…

It has to be a lie!

Because Papa said it was an accident during an experiment…

That when [HERO2] and I were still little, we were fooling around in the lab and got the cultured Vol Cells dumped all over our heads…

Was that a lie? Why? Why!?
Don't tell me… her father experimented on them?

Twelve years ago, my son…

received it from a research institute he knew, as a new species of microorganism!

The more we studied it, the stranger the cell turned out to be. My son and I were both completely captivated…

It was a kind of archaeal cell… And we were convinced this discovery was the first great leap for a new humanity…
The first great leap?
Because no method on Earth, no matter what we tried… could kill Vol Cells!
They… couldn't be killed…?

We thought we had obtained eternal youth and immortality! That we could create the perfect human being…

And so, before anyone else, we made Vol Cells live in symbiosis with you two! We meant to entrust humanity's future to you, who would carry the new era…
And then they went out of control… The Vol Cells ran wild, beyond Dr. Hinata's reach…
Exactly… By the time we noticed, it was already…
Then, my brother and the others too?
Mm… Satoru was also one of the test subjects.
Kaori and Tatsuya too?

No… Assistant Minoshima's daughter and young Todo were never test subjects in the first place!

Most likely… Satoru chose those two as test subjects himself. Now that the institute has been burned down, there's no way to find out, but…
Satoru chose those two? For what…?

It's a lie…

I don't believe it! Papa… Papa would… Grandpa, you liar! Liaaar!
Then… in your view, Director, it's already been occupied by aliens?
It's hard to believe… but there are signs that the ship is not friendly toward us.
Even so… we cannot recklessly point our guns at our own people!
So we have decided to convene an Earth Defense Conference at the International Science Center.
An Earth Defense Conference?

As a worldwide defense conference, its scale is unprecedented in history…

A great many scientists and dignitaries from every nation are expected to attend.

They will discuss how to deal with the space fortress, as well as countermeasures based on the damage that the various evil organizations have done around the world…

This conference must be a success, without fail!
So we want the Ultra Garrison to handle its security. In a central role among the other defense units…
Sir… I'll have them sortie at once!

uncertain: U10580-U10581: one narration split over two rows; cut at the matching point.
U10584: Dan uses 私 here; "I agree with Soga, too."

U10606/U10607/U10624: the Japanese has 迫水 written out, not [HERO1]; rendered "Sakomizu" (glossary Kiichi/Takuma Sakomizu). If the player renames the hero this will not match; the insert tool may need [HERO1] here.
U10612: 宇宙探査船NAAGER kept in capitals as in the Japanese, distinct from the fortress "Naager".
U10616: まさか？俺たちを！？ completed as "You've been deceiving us!?" from U10617's reply (騙したり).
U10619: 階総 read as 階級 "rank"; 披える read as 纏える "clad myself in"; 轟機鋼 as "the Roaring Steel" (glossary subtitle).
U10620: 漆黒の騎士 rendered "Knight of Darkness" (distinct from 黒騎士 "Black Knight").
U10623: 銀河連邦S総指名手配犯 read as S級 "S-Class Most Wanted criminal of the Galactic Federation".
U10638: Kotaro asks whether [HERO4]'s father experimented on them; "her father" used since Seijiro says it is [HERO4]'s father.
U10639: 古細菌細胞 rendered "archaeal cell".
U10652 is absent from the batch (numbering gap).

new_names.why: SIDO's full name, not in glossary
alien life form, not in glossary
armor term, from glossary subtitle Lucifard, the Roaring Steel
